arStrings.szText:
Casting a {c_important}Juggernaut{/c} Skill consumes {c_number}[SF_11]{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}, giving your {c_important}Juggernaut{/c} Skills {c_number}[SF_12*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage and gain {c_number}[SF_13*100|%|]{/c} increased size for {c_number}[SF_9]{/c} seconds.

Your Minimum {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} is increased by {c_number}[SF_2]{/c} and is no longer consumed when getting hit.
